$comment: Balance-workbench parameter registry (sweep.py validates knobs and ranges against this file). MEASUREMENT ONLY: sweeps inject values at sim runtime and never touch data files or shipped constants — a winning value gets committed as the real constant/data afterwards, at which point the baseline ceremony (INVARIANTS #9) applies. ADDING A KNOB (the pattern): (1) if the value lives on enemy STATES, teach sim_runner._resolve_tuning/_apply_state_scalars a new key (state_scalar kind); (2) if it lives in the ENGINE, replace the constant/inline read in combat_manager with _tuned_int/_tuned_float("your_key", SHIPPED_VALUE) — defaults MUST be the shipped value so an empty tuning dict is byte-identical (ci_smoke proves it); (3) declare it here with id, kind, scope, path, default, range; (4) run ci_smoke (zero drift) and tests/sim_determinism.sh. THIRD KIND — ability_field: a path into heroes.data.json (tuning key 'ability:heroId/PathName|base/AbilityName/field'), resolved IN MEMORY against DataManager's loaded hero data at sim spawn (sim_runner._apply_ability_field_tuning) and NEVER written to disk; declare the knob here with a 'tuning_key' and sweep.py translates the knob id automatically. Adding one costs a knobs.json entry only — no engine or data change.

knobs.scope: per_op (use key@op, e.g. enemy_hp_scalar@hive) or global
knobs.path: sim_runner._apply_state_scalars — enemy max_hp/current_hp at spawn and on summons (round, min 1)
knobs.notes: Multiplies every enemy HP pool in runs on the qualified op. Data law (enemy HP multiple of 5) applies only to AUTHORED values; swept pools may land off-grid.

knobs.path: sim_runner._apply_state_scalars — enemy state dmg_scale at spawn and on summons
knobs.notes: Multiplies enemy ability damage via the existing dmg_scale state field (rounded per hit by the engine).
THE BROOD spawns a Bloodmite every N rounds (integer; runner clamps >=1).
Flat Execute bonus damage below the threshold. DECISIONS_RESOLVED #9 is ruled-pending — sweep to inform, do not ship without the transcribed ruling.
Chain jump damage as a fraction of base (floor). Amplifier directive still overrides to 100%. Shipped default set 0.6→0.5 in Batch-1 (Kev 2026-07-11, DECISIONS_RESOLVED #10).
